[Conference call notes and action log]

Attendees:
- Prospecta: Ellen Morris (Head of Security), Raj Singh (Compliance), Lisa Chen (AppSec)
- Redwood: Mina Haddad (Security), Marissa Cole (CS), Aditya Rao (Solutions)

Summary: 30-min intake to confirm scope of CAIQ and evidence owners. We walked through high-priority sections and agreed to a small evidence handoff window.

Key decisions / clarifications:
1) Encryption & key custody: Redwood uses customer-data encryption at rest with optional bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via KMS integrations. For Prospecta, we noted they will require keys to remain in their AWS KMS account. Action: Redwood security to provide BYOK integration guide and sample KMS policy. (Owner: Mina; due: 2026-11-19)

2) Subprocessors: Redwood will provide a complete subprocessor roster (name, role, contract link, region). We will exclude internal MSP-only entries. Action: Marissa to export the latest vendor list and drop CSV in shared Drive. (Owner: Marissa; due: 2026-11-18)

3) Logging & retention: Prospecta requested 12 months retention for audit logs and examples of redacted logs. Action: Mina to provide a sample log extract (sanitized) and a retention table mapping. (Owner: Mina; due: 2026-11-20)

4) CAIQ prefill: We talked through items we left blank. Redwood will prefill recommended answers and mark anything that requires Prospecta confirmation. Action: Mina to upload updated redwood_prefill_caiq_v2.xlsx (Owner: Mina; due: 2026-11-19)

Artifacts we agreed to share after the call (attachments listed and Drive link will be posted by Prospecta):
- redwood_prefill_caiq_v2.xlsx (updated answers, marked items)
- system_architecture_v2.pdf (network diagram, data flows)
- access_control_matrix.csv (roles and permissions mapping)

Follow-ups:
- Prospecta to create Drive folder and invite redwood_security@redwood.com (Ellen) — expected by EOD 17 Nov.
- Redwood to deliver the three artifacts and BYOK guide by the due dates above.
